name: @dev-mainsequence/devtools
description: Shared MainSequence developer actions, MCP client, and Codex and OpenCode V2 adapters

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-opencode.cjs && node scripts/build-plugin.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-opencode.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.opencode.json
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/check-release.cjs && node scripts/pack-plugin.cjs && npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination artifacts && npm run verify:package
